title: HomeGuard Homeowners Policy Loss Settlement Condition — Contents Settled Basis
content:
**Loss settlement condition, personal property (contents) — HomeGuard Homeowners Policy**

**(a)** When the contents replacement-cost value is at or below the tier's no-holdback threshold, the contents settled basis is the full replacement-cost value less the deductible absorbed.

**(b)** When the contents replacement-cost value is above that threshold and a release of withheld contents depreciation stands on the claim, the contents settled basis is the smaller of the replacement-cost value and the largest documented replacement cost on those releases, less the deductible absorbed.

**(c)** Where the contents replacement-cost value is above the threshold and no release of withheld contents depreciation stands on the claim, neither paragraph (a) nor paragraph (b) applies.

**Definitions for this condition.** The contents replacement-cost value is the one recorded on the claim's actual-cash-value initial payment entry for personal property. A release of withheld contents depreciation is a release entry of withheld personal-property depreciation on the claim, made against documented completion of repair or replacement; the documented replacement cost of a release is the documented cost actually incurred that the release entry records. Where several releases stand, the largest documented figure among them is the one compared with the replacement-cost value. The deductible absorbed is the part of the occurrence deductible the contents absorb on the claim.

**No-holdback threshold by package**

| Package | No-holdback threshold (USD) |
|---|---|
| HomeGuard HO-3 Essential | 0 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | 1000 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | 2500 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | 1000 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | 2500 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | 10000 |

"At or below" includes equality: on HomeGuard HO-5 Signature a contents replacement-cost value of exactly 10000.00 falls under paragraph (a), and 10000.01 is above the threshold. On HomeGuard HO-3 Essential only a replacement-cost value of 0.00 is at or below the threshold.

**Condition matrix**

| Replacement-cost value against the threshold | Release of withheld contents depreciation on the claim | Settled basis |
|---|---|---|
| At or below | Either | Full replacement-cost value less the deductible absorbed |
| Above | Stands | Smaller of the replacement-cost value and the largest documented replacement cost on the releases, less the deductible absorbed |
| Above | None | Paragraphs (a) and (b) do not apply |

**Hypothetical applications**

1. HomeGuard HO-5 Signature, contents replacement-cost value 9200.00, deductible absorbed 500.00: at or below 10000, settled basis 9200.00 less 500.00, that is 8700.00.
2. HomeGuard HO-3 Premier, contents replacement-cost value 14000.00, deductible absorbed 1000.00, releases on the claim recording documented costs of 9000.00 and 12600.00: the largest is 12600.00, smaller than 14000.00; settled basis 12600.00 less 1000.00, that is 11600.00.
3. Same as 2, but the largest documented cost is 15500.00: the replacement-cost value of 14000.00 is the smaller; settled basis 13000.00.
4. HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced, contents replacement-cost value 6000.00 with no release on the claim: paragraph (c).
